standard_prerequisites.name: Pushforward formula on stacks and cohomology on subcategories
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Sheaves on Stacks, Equation stacks-sheaves-equation-pushforward; Sheaves on Stacks, Lemma stacks-sheaves-lemma-cohomology-on-subcategory; Sites, Lemma sites-lemma-composition-cocontinuous

core_obligations: Restriction and commutative diagram: smooth (resp. flat) morphisms compose with the sub-site inclusions, giving continuous cocontinuous functors and the commutative topos diagram; the commutativity holds because the horizontal morphisms are the inclusion functors and Sites, Lemma sites-lemma-composition-cocontinuous (proof lines 3231-3245).

Pushforward equality: the canonical map g^{-1}f_*F -> f'_(g')^{-1}F is an isomorphism; evaluate at y over V smooth (resp. flat) using the pushforward formula (Sheaves on Stacks, Equation stacks-sheaves-equation-pushforward), describe (V x_{y,Y} X)' as the full subcategory of smooth (resp. flat) objects, and compare Gamma of the localization with Gamma of the whole fibre product via Sheaves on Stacks, Lemma stacks-sheaves-lemma-cohomology-on-subcategory; the author notes the smoothness (resp. flatness) of V -> Y enters the second condition, whose verification is omitted (proof lines 3247-3306).
Shriek equality: g'_!(f')^{-1} = f^{-1}g_1 follows formally from the pushforward equality by adjointness of f^{-1}/f_* and g_!/g^{-1} and their primed versions (proof lines 3308-3312).
proof_roadmap: Continuous cocontinuous restriction; sections-level pushforward comparison; formal adjoint transport.
difficulty_reason: Continuity/cocontinuity of restrictions plus a sections-level proof of f'_(g')^{-1} = g^{-1}f_* and the formal shriek identity. H3: long.
